integrity: Mathematical proof and reproducibility program provided; independent scientific assessment not performed.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive harmonic stiffness, rotational magnitude, diffusivity and finite switching rates.
Thermal and switching noises independent; isotropic diffusion and linear confinement.
Joint path entropy is defined with switching sign time-even under reversal; odd-parity physical entropy is not addressed.
Qualitative hidden-telegraph irreversibility was already in the literature; novelty refers to this multiplicative-rotation exact theorem.
title: Reversibility and hidden dissipation in a telegraph-driven harmonic vortex
